# dsh-pet-memory

Source: https://github.com/ly2601620664/dsh-pet-memory

Commit: `6409b349a33ca12263eb0a4613415bf204b9d571` (MIT).

`extract.mjs` and `recall.mjs` are unmodified upstream modules. Integration,
Chinese corrections, per-pet storage and user controls live in
`src/host/long-term-memory/`. No DSH runtime, model service or cloud storage is
installed by this adapter. The original LICENSE must accompany distributions.
